mapper.insert: insert into im_conversation_member (conversation_id, member_id, role, unread_count, last_read_msg_id, muted, deleted, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, 0, 0, 0, 0, sysdate())
mapper.select: select id, conversation_id, member_id, role, unread_count, last_read_msg_id, muted, deleted, create_time from im_conversation_member where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1

select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.member_id, m.role, m.unread_count, m.last_read_msg_id, m.muted, m.deleted, m.create_time from im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.deleted = 0 and c.status = 0 order by c.last_msg_at desc
select id, conversation_id, member_id, role, unread_count, last_read_msg_id, muted, deleted, create_time from im_conversation_member where conversation_id = #{conversationId} for update
mapper.update: update im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id and c.status = 0 set m.unread_count = m.unread_count + #{delta}, m.deleted = 0 where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(m.unread_count), 0) from im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id and c.status = 0 where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.deleted = 0 and m.muted = 0
mapper.update: update im_conversation_member set deleted = 1 where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId}
update im_conversation_member set deleted = 1, unread_count = 0 where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
update im_conversation_member set muted = #{muted} where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId}
